test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Arrogance inflames prejudice and hatred, but humble speech soothes.

B. Humility is the quality of being courteously respectful of others.

C. It is the opposite of arrogance, aggressiveness and vanity.

D. Thus, a humble demeanour is what is required to live in peace.
solution:
The correct sequence is 'BCAD'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting off a story, starting of an incident or an event, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
• **Sentence B **will be the first sentence because it is an independent general statement.
 
• **Sentence C** will be the next sentence because this sentence explains how humility is the opposite of arrogance, aggressiveness, and vanity.
 
• **Sentence A** will be the next sentence because it is connected with **Sentence C.**
 
• Lastly,** Sentence D **will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **B**: Humility is the quality of being courteously respectful of others.
 
• **C**: It is the opposite of arrogance, aggressiveness and vanity.
 
• **A**: Arrogance inflames prejudice and hatred, but humble speech soothes.
 
• **D**: Thus, a humble demeanour is what is required to live in peace.

 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *Humility is the quality of being courteously respectful of others. It is the opposite of arrogance, aggressiveness and vanity. Arrogance inflames prejudice and hatred, but humble speech soothes. Thus, a humble demeanour is what is required to live in peace.*
